hotelDesc.overview:
Escape to Tranquility at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

Nestled amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Hanoi, Vietnam, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offers a serene and luxurious escape for travelers seeking tranquility and relaxation. With its 4.5-star rating, this enchanting hotel promises a memorable stay with its impeccable service and stunning surroundings. As you step into Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, you will be greeted by a warm and inviting ambiance. The hotel boasts a total of 55 beautifully appointed rooms, each thoughtfully designed to provide the utmost comfort and convenience. Whether you choose a cozy Deluxe Room or indulge in the spaciousness of a Suite, you can expect a haven of tranquility where you can unwind and rejuvenate. Check-in at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat begins from 02:00 PM, allowing you to start your retreat at your own pace. The check-out time is until 11:00 AM, giving you ample time to savor the hotel's serene surroundings before bidding farewell. Located just 55 kilometers away from the city center, this idyllic retreat offers a peaceful respite from the hustle and bustle of urban life. The journey to the airport takes approximately 120 minutes, ensuring a seamless transition between your mountain getaway and your return home. Please note that Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat has a child policy in place. While children are welcome to stay at the hotel, they may be subject to additional charges. The hotel's friendly staff will be more than happy to provide you with detailed information regarding the child policy, ensuring a hassle-free stay for you and your loved ones. So, whether you are seeking a romantic escape, a family vacation, or a peaceful retreat, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat is the perfect destination to create lasting memories.

Unwind and Indulge in Luxurious Entertainment Facilities at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, you can unwind and indulge in a wide range of luxurious entertainment facilities that will leave you feeling rejuvenated and pampered. Whether you're in the mood for a refreshing drink or a relaxing massage, this retreat has it all. Start your evening by sipping on your favorite cocktail at the stylish bar, where you can enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. If you're in need of some pampering, head to the spa and indulge in a soothing massage or unwind in the hot tub, sauna, or steam room. The spa also offers a range of treatments to revitalize your mind, body, and soul. For nature lovers, the retreat boasts a beautiful garden where you can take a leisurely stroll and immerse yourself in the serene surroundings. If you prefer to relax indoors, the shared lounge/TV area provides a cozy space to unwind and catch up on your favorite shows. Don't forget to visit the gift/souvenir shop to pick up some unique mementos to remember your stay. With its exceptional entertainment facilities, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offers the perfect blend of relaxation and indulgence. Whether you're seeking tranquility or excitement, this retreat has something to cater to every guest's needs.

Unleash Your Inner Athlete at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, we believe in catering to the needs of our sporty guests. Our sports facilities are designed to provide you with a wide range of options to stay active and fit during your stay. Whether you prefer to hit the gym, take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool, or explore the lush surroundings on our hiking trails, we have something for everyone. Our state-of-the-art fitness center is fully equipped with the latest exercise machines and equipment, allowing you to maintain your workout routine even while on vacation. With our 24-hour access, you can exercise at your convenience, whether it's early in the morning or late at night. Best of all, our fitness center is completely free for all guests, so you can stay in shape without any extra charges. For those who prefer to enjoy the great outdoors, our outdoor pool is the perfect place to cool off and unwind. Take a leisurely swim or simply relax by the poolside, soaking up the sun and enjoying the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. And if you're up for a more adventurous activity, our hiking trails offer a chance to explore the natural beauty of Ba Vi National Park. Lace up your hiking boots and embark on a journey through lush forests, cascading waterfalls, and stunning vistas. At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, we understand the importance of staying active and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. With our top-notch sports facilities, you can indulge in your favorite activities and make the most of your stay in Hanoi, Vietnam.

Convenience Facilities at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

Experience seamless comfort and effortless convenience during your stay at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, where a range of thoughtful facilities await to enhance your visit. Guests can enjoy the ease of free Wi-Fi available in all rooms and public areas, ensuring you stay connected whether you're relaxing in your room or exploring the scenic surroundings. For added convenience, the hotel offers express check-in and check-out services, along with luggage storage and daily housekeeping to keep your stay hassle-free. Safety is prioritized with secure safety deposit boxes, while dry cleaning and laundry services ensure your wardrobe stays fresh and ready for your adventures. For your dining and relaxation needs, room service is available, allowing you to enjoy delicious meals in the comfort of your room. The hotel also features a designated smoking area for those who wish to smoke in designated spaces. Additional amenities such as a cozy fireplace create a warm, inviting atmosphere, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring. The attentive concierge service is on hand to assist with your needs, making your stay at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat both convenient and memorable.

Convenient Transport Facilities at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, guests can enjoy a range of convenient transport facilities to enhance their stay. The hotel offers airport transfer services, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free journey to and from the Hanoi airport. For those looking to explore the beautiful surroundings, the hotel provides tours, allowing guests to discover the stunning landscapes and cultural attractions of Ba Vi National Park and its surroundings. In terms of parking options, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offers both valet parking and self-parking facilities. Guests can choose to have their vehicles parked by the friendly and efficient valet staff or opt for the convenience of self-parking. Additionally, the hotel has an onsite car park, making it easy for guests to park their vehicles securely. Please note that car park charges may apply. For those who prefer to travel by taxi, the hotel provides a taxi service, ensuring that guests can easily explore the city and its attractions. Furthermore, the hotel offers a ticket service, allowing guests to conveniently book tickets for various activities and attractions in and around Hanoi. With these transport facilities, Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat ensures that guests have everything they need for a comfortable and stress-free stay.

Cozy Rooms with Fireplace at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

Immerse yourself in the warmth and comfort of the rooms at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, where a cozy fireplace awaits. Each room is thoughtfully designed to provide a serene and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for a mountain getaway. The fireplace adds a touch of charm and elegance, creating a cozy ambiance that will make you feel right at home. Indulge in the luxury of a crackling fire as you unwind after a day of exploring the beautiful Ba Vi National Park. The rooms are spacious and tastefully decorated, featuring modern amenities and plush furnishings. Curl up with a book or enjoy a cup of hot cocoa by the fireplace, and let the flickering flames create a soothing backdrop to your stay. Whether you're visiting for a romantic escape or a family vacation, the rooms at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat offer the perfect retreat. With a fireplace in each room, you can enjoy the ultimate in comfort and relaxation. Experience the magic of a mountain retreat and create unforgettable memories at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat.

Indulge in Culinary Delights at Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat

At Melia Ba Vi Mountain Retreat, dining is an experience to be savored. With a variety of dining facilities available, guests can indulge in culinary delights throughout their stay. Start your day off right at the breakfast buffet, where a wide selection of freshly prepared dishes awaits.
